name: QBR pack
summary: One series from a workbook, packaged for the quarterly review.
description: QBR pack is a config-backed plugin that is not the historical tracker: it declares the workbook config kind and otherwise gets the same per-instance setup flow, read gate, cap, and dashboard cards as the bundled tracker. It writes nothing, uses no network, and does not call a model on its own.
highlights: Declares the workbook kind; the host supplies the whole setup flow.
You open the workbook and confirm the columns.
A separate instance namespace from every other plugin.
